lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in approximately five irregular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the highest density concentrated in the mid-lateral flank region above the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal alignment of blobs to form a distorted grid-like lattice in the posterior-lateral quadrant.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary longitudinal ridges visible running horizontally across the mid-to-upper flank, defined by a distinct light-to-shadow gradient transition along the dorsal-ventral axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral surface and beneath the pectoral fin.
